board: Winsen MH-Z19C terminal version with 7-pin JST cable
reason: Pinout from the Winsen MH-Z19C manual v1.2 terminal table and Fig4 (1 HD, 2 reserved, 3 GND, 4 Vin, 5 RXD, 6 TXD, 7 PWM). The driver uses the datasheet's 0x86 read and 0x79 ABC commands with the (0xFF - sum)+1 checksum, and the sim reply encodes HIGH*256+LOW. The check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run.
